TITLE: RTGS / NEFT
RTGS_DESC_1: RTGS is a real-time fund transfer system where the processing and settlement of transactions take place instantly on a transaction-by-transaction basis.
RTGS_DESC_2: It is the fastest interbank money transfer facility available through secure banking channels in India.
NEFT_DESC_1: NEFT is an electronic fund transfer system that operates on a Deferred Net Settlement basis.
NEFT_DESC_2: In NEFT, transactions are settled in batches at specific intervals rather than continuously, making it suitable for routine fund transfers.
RTGS_REAL_TIME: Real-time processing and settlement of transactions.
RTGS_GROSS: Transactions are settled individually without netting.
RTGS_FAST: Fastest method for large-value interbank fund transfers.
RTGS_SECURE: Highly secure fund transfer through regulated banking channels.
NEFT_BATCH: Transactions are settled in batches at regular intervals.
NEFT_WIDE_USAGE: Widely used for retail and corporate fund transfers.
NEFT_CONVENIENT: No need for demand drafts or cheques.
NEFT_SECURE: Safe and reliable electronic fund transfer system.
